slides.sub: A landmark from 1888, a park from about 1903 and a library card. Swipe for all 3.

slides.title: Butler Museum
slides.body: It's inside the red 1888 railroad station, listed on the State and National Registers. Next open day: Sat., Nov. 21.
slides.source: Borough of Butler, Butler Museum page (Nov. 2026)

slides.title: Butler Borough Park
slides.meta: High St and Park Pl, Butler
slides.body: Stone House Brook runs through it, with footbridges, war memorials, an iron fountain and a holiday light display.

slides.title: Butler Public Library
slides.body: Weekly story time and toddler time, plus a book club. Check the calendar before you go.

slides.title: One afternoon in Butler
slides.tip: Butler's old train station is a museum now. Time your drive to work at rush hour before you make an offer.

caption:
Butler's red 1888 train station is now a free museum on Main St, open the 1st and 3rd Saturday of each month. Add the borough park and the library and you've got an easy afternoon. Which stop would you hit first?
